plugins.name: day-trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading on NSE: a chart scanner, a news and NSE filings monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner on NSE's tick, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order executor for FYERS (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, an earnings analyst and a backtester that replays a year of NSE sessions after charges.
